reviews.comment: The best class I have taken at TAMU! I never knew how much I could love this style of writing, and this proff helped guide me to find a passion for it. Not only was he flexible and open to feedback, but his lectures were fun and often got my brain running through dozens of ideas. Group feedback on your personal writing was a blast! Super reccomend!
You have to read a lot, be ready.

Some short essays, class participation, participation in DnD-like game sessions made up the majority of our grades when I took this this class. Lecture heavy but I really liked going through the themes. Our version of the class showed a cool progression of sci-fi through the years. We read both classic sci-fi (Asimov) and much more new-school stuff
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Overall a pretty good professor and a really easy class. It is obvious he knows what he is teaching about and he is very knowledgeable. Expect around 4-5 paper assignments. Criteria and grading expectations are clear, and attendance is graded at the very end. Would definitely recommend for ENGL104!
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Cooper fostered an open environment for creativity and discussion of the course material through prompting questions without taking over conversation. He was open to adjusting the pace the course and elements of the semester-long RPG campaign in response to student feedback.

Someone said outbursts, plural, which is false. He had 1! outburst, because 90% of the class obviously wasn't doing the readings or participating in class. Entirely valid. He's an engaging prof & the class is interesting. Don't take it if you don't like sci fi or reading. Only issue is that grades take a while to come back, with minimal feedback.

The expectations for the course are clear, and if you enjoy reading, you will enjoy it. However, Dr. Cooper's tendency to interrupt students and have outbursts can make the classroom environment unpredictable. While some students may be fine with this teaching style, I would not recommend taking the course with him.

Dr. Cooper was great! His lectures were very interesting. Attendance wasn't mandatory but it's a small class so I personally think it matters and participation in discussion was important. Only had a few relatively short papers, one presentation, and one novel (we also watched films, read poems, etc.). Pretty easy A if you do the work.

Super easy class. Not a tough grader, but his instructions for assignments are super vague and he gets snappy if asked for clarification. You can get away with not reading, but he cold calls sometimes. Professor has an interesting vibe to him and makes some strange comments. Constantly interrupts students while they're talking or presenting.
His expectations only exist in his brain, you will never be able to fully understand the prompt or how you should go about writing. CONSTANT CONFUSION!

LOVES to hear himself talk. Except when u have a question. I once asked him ab a prompt, and he said "If I can write a 12 pager about a sentence, you can write 3 about a whole poem". omg so helpful! (its like this every time). Group discussions are j him interupting and overshadowing student ideas. I'm great at english, but im not learning in here

One of the best professors I ever met. He understood the students' needs and was very thoughtful and insightful. In addition, you have a lot of time in class to finish homework assignments and if you show up to class, it is an easy A. A pretty small class (around 10 - 20 students) and there was a lot of interaction and collaboration.

I took this class for my comm credit but It's been one of my most enjoyable classes this semester! The textbook is used for reference and provided by the prof. The book he chose for us to read is also very interesting. His lectures are entertaining and engaging. It's not too writing-heavy, and he's an easy grader. Take him!
Professor Cooper is very responsive outside of class and is very entertaining and enlightening during classes. The work isn't too hard and Professor Cooper is fair in his grading.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took this class during the summer as a short class and there was a lot to do, but it was the easiest class I have ever taken. He was very nice, understanding, and responded super fast to emails. Incredibly easy grader as long as you follow the formatting and your paper sounds somewhat decent. Loved this class!

Dr. Cooper is a super chill man. I would get most of my writing done in class and was never stressed. If you show up and show interest, you'll be fine. It is super fun and interesting. You write about things you are interested in. Super super fun and easy.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment:
I didn't attend a very good high school, and English was always a struggle. So I was scared to take English at A&M. This guy made everything better. He explained everything, even when back to high school basics, which helped. The lectures were interesting. This guy helped me like English.

I look forward to taking ENGL210 with him in the summer.

Easy A but wouldn't want to be taught by this guy. He was really condescending and rude-- shamed someone for their taste in books & implied they weren't smart enough to read critically, told me I didn't know how science worked (I was a junior STEM major at the time), & didn't seem to put much effort into teaching.

This was an English/Film class so no books just movies. Dr. Cooper is straight forward with you, do your work and he won't have any problems with you. Weekly discussions on movies and  weekly 2 page responses on each film. One final paper. Very passionate about the material which makes the class interesting. Taking him again next semester.

Great professor. Properly understands the needs of his students and is able to teach and communicate the lesson properly. Actually knows how to use Canvas and is very responsive in and out of the class. Felt super comfortable in his class and didn't hesitate to ask any questions. I would definitely recommend him for future students.
This is my favorite professor Ive had at A&M so far (: no exams, just major project grades. If you just do the work youll be fine!

He doesn't make the class harder than it needs to be. As long as you do the daily writings and give moderate effort on papers you will do well. He tries to make sure that the literature we studied in the class was actually interesting as well. He loves sci-fi so we read a lot of that. Overall, he's an easy grader who will try to keep things fun.

This is a literature class so get ready to read obviously. As a prof he is pretty reasonable. Fun dude who is always in good spirits. A little passive aggressive at times but that can be overlooked. You do read long novels but the way he makes his tests doesnt really require you to read the whole book so that is a positive.

Don't take 331 as an easy course! Dr. Cooper is passionate and makes a lot of the reading very analytical, it is a hard class unless you are passionate about fantasy literature. Tests are LONG, they are open note and open answer, you can work with your group while you take them they normally each take a couple of hours.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Test heavy

reviews.comment: One of the best I've had! Dr. Cooper is funny, personable, and a great guy. He does expect you to read the material provided and discuss it in class, and he gets annoyed when it is obvious you haven't read. He makes you work to earn your grade but gives great feedback and is all-around a wonderful professor. Taking him again next semester!

Professor Cooper is a knowledgeable and funny professor. This semester, he had to replace the original ENGL 235 professor due to medical complications. However, professor Cooper gave insightful lectures, writing advice, and feedback that helped me significantly improve my writing! Good professor and great opportunities for feedback on your writing
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Very lenient on grading papers. As long as you know the basic English mechanics (punctuation, capitalization, etc.), you will pass. I took this class in a half-semester during the summer, so the workload was immense but as long as you stay on top of it, you will get an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed this class with this professor! While there was a LOT of essays to write, the workload was manageable with the way it was spaced out throughout the semester.
Overall a great professor. I am by no means a great writer but he gives excellent feedback and help, and he will not grade very harshly if you attend class and appear to be interested.

Dr. Cooper is an alright teacher. He doesn't require going to class, but he grades easier if you do go. A few stories that you need to read throughout the semester outside of class, but nothing too bad. Definitely seems like he likes people that come to class and participate more.

So I took the science fiction creative writing class. Not a hard class, you just need to ALWAYS BE PREPARED & READ THE MATERIAL BEFORE CLASS OR HE WILL MAKE YOU LOOK LIKE A FOOL. If he doesnt like you, he will call you out in front of the class and belittle you. If you have a technical difficulty with turning something in he gives you no grace :(
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Lots of discussion board posts but they are definitely manageable. There is one 'major' grade a week but the only paper I spent more than an hour on was the final recommendation report. He replies to emails quick. I turned in my discussions/papers on time & followed the criteria and never scored below a 97. You'll need the book for reference
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: Honestly during the first few classes I really liked him but then as the semester went on I started to see him as bitter. He would leave snide remarks on our daily writing assignments for no reason at all. Feedback on essays was limited at best and usually derogatory. Lectures weren't too bad and an A is possible. Go to class. He will respect you.

Dr Rich was fantastic and hilarious- hes a little vulgar at times, but honestly its refreshing. He breaks this sci fi class down into skill trees and he doesnt really enforce due dates until the end of the class. Its really important that you actually are doing the assignments along with the readings or else its super hard to catch up.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Prof. Cooper is very fair and helpful. Helped take some of the intimidation that comes from writing away. cares a lot about his students. A few big papers he helps with, then in class participation and online modules. You can basically determine your grade by your effort. Easy to make an A if you try. Great English class, must go to class.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Little hw, takes attendance but hates you if you miss sometimes. Bro, I crossed the red sea MWF to get to class EVEN FRIDAYS when no one was there. As a STEM major, I face death every day and gave this class my full effort on big assignments and he would grade so hard. He seems pissed off at the world and bitter... chill out cooper fr. lowest grade

I thoroughly enjoyed Dr. Richs FantasyLit class. I wouldve done better if I hadnt fallen behind on the series readings, but if you put in the time (esp if taken during the summer), you will be just fine. Its an extremely creative way of structuring a literature class. Highly recommend for a fun one! (Textbook use as in the Earthsea series).
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Overall, Dr. Cooper is a good professor for anyone needing to take an English course. I would give him 5 stars, except I felt like I never knew what he really wanted out of my major papers. He would give me 100s and feedback saying all of my weekly writings were great, then rip apart my major writings with demeaning comments and give me a B.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers

reviews.comment: He was really sweet. Always gave us days off when we had papers due, gave clear feedback. As long as you turned in a draft or did the daily work, you got a 100. wasn't harsh on essays but I'm a good writer. you can find the textbook online everywhere for free so don't buy it. no work outside of class except for big papers. really nice.

I was very worrisome taking a composition class because I never thought essays were my strong suit but I ended up getting high 90's on all my essays in this class. The material that we base our essays on was very interesting which made the class not at all boring. Attendance was mandatory but his attitude in class was very real and funny.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I am coming back here to give him 5 stars because he honestly deserves it. After taking him and many other English Classes he is GREAT. NO EXAMS. There are pop quizzes but it beats being stressed about an exam. TAKE HIM. You have to put in the work, but it was the most beneficial English class I ever took. And he allows a few skips.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Dr. Cooper is now one of my all-time FAVORITE professors. The books we read were enlightening, entertaining, and thought-provoking. Class participation is a major part of this course, everyone led a class discussion. He brings up interesting points for each book. It IS an English course - you'll be reading lots of books and writing papers, duh.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Extremely demeaning. If your thoughts align with his you will be ok, otherwise he will call you out and make you feel terrible. Very demeaning in the way he speaks to and emails students. In the beginning he claimed an open minded teaching pedagogy, this was not the case. He will cut you off and tell you that you are wrong in the middle of speaking
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Dr. Cooper is an awesome professor that brings a lot of humor to the class. Your graded on 3 essays and your class attendance. He was tough on essay grading but gave good feedback. I did seek help on essays from dr cooper but didnt get much help. Overall good professor but strongly reccomend the writing center!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: If you're someone who's looking for a basic ENGL104 course don't take this class. Rich takes his class to the next level by making the content interesting, you really have to think deeply about things. That being said I think this class is awesome, and an easy-A if you participate, and get your rough drafts checked during office hours.

Dr. Cooper is a super cool guy. He is super personable. You don't HAVE to read the books he assigns but then have to sort of skim it for quotes and make stuff up. You definitely have to put in effort though on the papers (no tests). But he is typically willing to help if you tell him you are going to office hours or ask him after class. I loved him

Dr. Cooper was my favorite prof at the beginning of the semester, but throughout the semester he became less committed to his students. Without notice, He didn't show up to his office hours when I went and gave no explanation/didn't apologize to any students that waited on him. Is either in a great mood or horrible mood. Grades fairly easy though.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: I DO NOT RECOMMEND THE SCI-FI 8AM. He takes attendance everyday and with my class he said after 8:05am you're absent. YOU WILL NOT PASS IF YOU DO NOT READ EVERY BOOK (12 BOOKS). The lectures are boring, basically reads whats on the powerpoint. no essays, pop quizzes, just attendance and exams is what your grade consists of. I took him in Fall 2017.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Cooper is a great professor. He knows his stuff. His tests are ridiculously hard though, and the work load he gives you is absolutely absurd. Do not take this professor if you are taking more than 9 hours. You have to read a novel a week, which is hard when you are taking 4 other classes. He can be rude too.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Your grade consists of 3 tests. It is an 8am and attendance is mandatory. Miss three classes and you drop a letter grade. He also assigned us assigned seats to keep role so that students couldn't count you there when you were not. He has very detailed questions so you need to take intense notes while reading the books (3 books per test).
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: One of my favorite professors. He's funny and his class is really enjoyable. He's very clear about the work that is do. As long as you do the work and put effort into discussion you will be fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Best professor. Very respectful and helpful
So funny and super handsome guy to talk with.

I love him. He is an extremely chill guy. As long as you get your work done and read you shouldn't have any problems. He's not out to trick you or make your life harder. Offers a good amount of extra credit. Great lecturers.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Long readings having to be done in such a short amount of time.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Dr. Cooper is an awesome professor. His lectures were funny and interesting, although there was a fair amount of cussing. Not homework light, but not heavy either. His office hours were very helpful, and it's a cakewalk to get an A. You will read a lot of sci-fi, which I personally found very interesting. He is relaxed, but wants you to learn too.

Follow the instructions he gives in class, listen and participate. He loves it if you bring up new ideas and can talk half the class about androids or sci-fi becoming our reality if you let him. But super interesting class, makes you think, and not hard if you put in any effort at all.

Get ready to laugh! this professor rocks, he doesn't waste your time if there is nothing for you to do he lets you go and he candles class pretty often. The reading material is interesting and a good read, and there are no tests just essays. So be ready to write but his office hours help a lot for editing of papers.

Cooper is seriously the most unprofessional professor I've had yet. His emails are demeaning, the assignments he gives on Ecampus are unclear, and he grades things ridiculously slow. He's some young fantasy-obsessed guy and EVERY book assigned in the class was weird sci-fi novel. Don't take this guy, its not worth it even if he's the last prof open
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Dr. Cooper does a great job of introducing abstract concepts in a very digestible way. I thoroughly enjoyed attending his class. However, I found the tests to be ridiculously difficult.
Best English professor I've ever had.

I took Rich Cooper for ENGL 210 online over the summer. All the assignments are very clearly defined and as long as you follow instructions you can make an A. Also, you don't have to read the textbook but simply glance at it and use it when working on the assignments. It is a good class to take even if you feel you are not a strong writer.

Even though I am not an English major, this class is one of the best I have taken. Dr. Cooper is a fantastic professor, but I will say that he is not the fairest grader in the world. Like many other teachers, I think he forgets that most students have other classes to study for and do not have 10-15 hours a week to devote to one class.

If you're a strong writer, prepare to have your confidence crushed. He is a really nice prof, but he grades terribly hard. I went to office hours one time and they helped tremendously! If you have to take him, you'll be fine. If you have the option of switching then switch. Material we covered was all fantasy based, not your typical ENGL 104 class.

Rich is a chill professor. He curses and makes the class enjoyable. However, this ENGL 104 class isn't as easy as others. He expects you to read VERY difficult, obscure novels about mushrooms and drugs. He is a HARD grader and is not afraid to tell you that your writing isn't up to his standards. He WILL give unfair pop quizzes if you don't read.

Awesome guy, very relaxed and open to hear student opinions. He only gives quizzes when he suspects no one is paying attention and other than that there are a few papers due nothing very intense as long as you keep up with the reading. He's very willing to work with students. I highly recommend
